title: This Fish Shoots Down Insects With a Jet of Water Up to 2 Meters
subject: archerfish

scenes.text: A fish that fires water like a spear, and it never uses its fins to aim.
The archerfish spits at insects sitting on branches above the water, and knocks them down.
Here's the trick. The water starts slowly, then speeds up. The tail of the jet catches the front.
Everything lands at once, so a small stream hits like a punch. Jets have reached two meters.
It even corrects for refraction, which can make prey look up to 25 degrees off from where it really sits.
A fish that throws water like a spear, and hits.

description:
A fish that fires water like a spear.
The archerfish speeds up its jet so the whole stream lands at once, and it corrects for the way water bends light.
Would you rather have this superpower or a frog's tongue? Comment below.
first_comment: Which would you pick: a water jet or a frog's tongue?
